cd /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,collections
lines=open('server.log').read().splitlines()
print(len(lines))
pat=re.compile(r'^(\S+) (\S+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\S+) msg=(.*)$')
bad=[]; levels=collections.Counter(); codes=collections.Counter(); routes=collections.Counter(); lat_forms=collections.Counter()
for i,l in enumerate(lines,1):
    m=pat.match(l)
    if not m: bad.append((i,l)); continue
    ts,lv,u,r,c,lat,msg=m.groups()
    levels[lv]+=1; routes[r]+=1; codes[c]+=1
    lat_forms[re.sub(r'\d+','N',lat)]+=1
print('bad',bad[:5],len(bad))
print(levels); print(codes.most_common(10)); print(routes); print(lat_forms)
EOF

input.command:
cd /tmp/opencode/bench/log-analysis-baseline && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,collections,statistics
pat=re.compile(r'^(\S+) (\S+) user=(\S+) route=(\S+) code=(\S+) latency=(\S+) msg=(.*)$')
rows=[]
for l in open('server.log'):
    m=pat.match(l.rstrip('\n')); ts,lv,u,r,c,lat,msg=m.groups()
    rows.append((ts,lv,u,r,c,int(lat[:-2]),msg))
errs=[x for x in rows if x[1]=='ERROR']
print('errors',len(errs))
print('err codes',collections.Counter(x[4] for x in errs).most_common())
print('err code E000 count',sum(1 for x in errs if x[4]=='E000'))
ck=[x[5] for x in rows if x[3]=='/api/checkout']
print('checkout n',len(ck),'mean',sum(ck)/len(ck),round(sum(ck)/len(ck)))
to=[x for x in rows if 'timeout' in x[6].lower()]
print('timeout lines',len(to),'users',len(set(x[2] for x in to)))
print('msgs',collections.Counter(x[6] for x in to).most_common(10))
print('case-sensitive timeout',len([x for x in rows if 'timeout' in x[6]]))
f=[x for x in rows if x[1]=='FATAL']
print('fatal',len(f),'first',f[0][0],f[:3])
print('lat range',min(x[5] for x in rows),max(x[5] for x in rows))
EOF
